title.rendered: Auberge de Soleil Wedding DJ Rutherford

content.rendered:
Auberge de Soleil Wedding DJ Rutherford March 2014

What a great afternoon Wedding. Was pouring with rain early morning. But then it cleared before the Wedding Started.
Was so pretty, fantastic view over Napa Valley.

The food and wine is excellent there, I would recommend a visit.

What started out as dinner, quickly turned into dancing and good wine, drinks and food.
Good time was had by all and we even had some singers, dance floor was packed.
Even a person said to me at the end, do you see many weddings that are this rowdy during the day.:).
Its not the first time :). My british accent definatly helps me get the crowd going.

It Was like this all afternoon, But this was the final song.
